settings.title: Questions? We've Got Answers
settings.subtitle: Everything you need to know about animated greeting cards

settings.question: How do I send a card?
settings.answer: Choose any card from our library, add your personal message, then share the unique link via email, text, or any messaging app. Recipients can view it instantly on any device — no app download required.

settings.question: Can recipients reply to my card?
settings.answer: Yes! Recipients can send a short reply message directly from the card page. You'll receive it via email. This feature is available on Pro and Business plans.

settings.question: What if they don't receive the email?
settings.answer: Every card comes with a unique shareable link that never expires during the 90-day replay window. You can copy and re-send this link via any channel. You'll also see delivery confirmation in your dashboard.

settings.question: Can I schedule cards to be sent later?
settings.answer: Absolutely. With Pro and Business plans, you can schedule cards up to 12 months in advance. Perfect for remembering birthdays and anniversaries automatically.

settings.question: Do you have cards for business use?
settings.answer: Yes — our Business plan includes custom branding, team access for up to 5 seats, analytics, and API access for automated sending.

settings.question: Is there a free option?
settings.answer: Yes! Our free plan lets you send up to 3 animated cards per month with access to 12 basic templates. No credit card required to sign up.
